name: OmaCaffeine
author: Peter Sønderby
description: Track your caffeine so you peak while you code and still sleep tonight: log a cup, watch the mug fill, get a bedtime cut-off, and see how your week's milligrams line up with your coding agents' tokens. Made with love for coders, coffee and Omarchy.

barWidget.description: Caffeine tracker with a cup that fills up, a half-life model, a bedtime cut-off and a weekly caffeine × tokens view.

schema.label: Body weight (kg)
schema.description: Stored in kg; the panel shows pounds when your locale is imperial. Used for the recommended daily limit (5.7 mg per kg, capped at 400 mg).

schema.label: Typical day
schema.description: Rough activity level. Half-life 5 h sitting, 4.75 h standing, 4.5 h moving around.

schema.label: Optimal bedtime
schema.description: Stored as 24-hour HH:MM; the panel shows and accepts the Omarchy clock widget's format (locale format when no clock is configured).

schema.label: Daily limit (mg)
schema.description: The cup is full at this amount.

schema.label: Caffeine left at bedtime (mg)
schema.description: How much may still be in your system at bedtime. EFSA notes 100 mg close to bedtime may affect sleep.

schema.label: Cup shows
schema.description: Whether the cup fills with today's total or with what is currently in your system.
